input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including update info, banner info, url quality, live room info. The platform provides capabilities for area type index, area, user. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage update info records, so that I can track and organize update info data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage banner info records, so that I can track and organize banner info data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage url quality records, so that I can track and organize url quality data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage live room info records, so that I can track and organize live room info data effectively.
